note: The taxonomy ledger (D421, shaped by D422). A lane that meets a question fitting no existing category PARKS it here instead of dropping it, and scripts/topic-budget.mjs decides from this file whether the gap has become a category. The top level is FIXED at today's count (the owner, 2026-09-08) — growth goes into the tree, so a proposal is normally a LEAF under a levelled parent. Written by lanes through their own PR; read by npm run topic:budget; held honest by check:taxonomy. Empty is the correct state when no lane has met an unfittable question — proposals accumulate, they are not seeded.

shape.leaf: { id: 'sub_<slug>' (feed) | '<slug>' (learn), level: 'leaf', label, surface: 'feed' | 'learn', parent: <a topic or subject id>, retag: [existing feed question ids under the parent that are this leaf's — free stock], questions: [{ prompt, options?, run: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }] }
shape.top: { id, level: 'top', label, surface: 'daily' | 'feed' | 'learn', nearest: <the existing category it came closest to>, questions: [{ prompt, options?, run: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }] } — holds at the owner's cap; recorded as evidence
shape.created: { id, level, label, surface, parent?, createdAt: 'YYYY-MM-DD', pr }

surfaces.daily: top = cat[0], a key in CAT_META (src/v2/spec/daily-cats.js); the second level is the free path cat[1] — written on the question, never created
surfaces.feed: top = an id in WORLD_TOPICS (src/v2/spec/world-feed-topics.js) and in content/feed-questions.json topics; leaf = an id in WORLD_SUBTOPICS (src/v2/spec/world-subtopics.js), carried by a question as `sub`
surfaces.learn: top = a subject in content/learn-questions.json; leaf = a field there, carried by a card as `f`
